description: This file defines classes for handling configuration options in the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It includes classes for representing option values of various types and a class for managing a collection of options with default values, accessors, and conversions.
external_files: none explicitly referenced within the code snippet

classes.name: OptionValue
classes.description: Represents a single option value which can be retrieved in various formats such as object, int, bool, string, array, or callable.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Manages a collection of options with default values and provides methods to access options as different types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OptionValue with a given value.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the stored value as an object.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the stored value as an integer, defaulting to 0 if empty.

methods.name: asBool
methods.description: Returns the stored value as a boolean.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the stored value as a string.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the stored value as an array.

methods.name: asCallable
methods.description: Returns the stored value if it is callable, otherwise null.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the Options object with optional options array and defaults.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Allows property-like access to options, returning an OptionValue object.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns all options as an array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all options as a recursive merged array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an option value wrapped in an OptionValue object.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an option as an integer.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves an option as a string.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Retrieves an option as a boolean.
